# Publish product updates as a changelog page, a feed and a What's new bell

> Publish product updates on a public changelog page with Atom and JSON feeds and an embeddable What's new bell with an unread badge. Scheduled posts, drafts, Slack webhook. Open source, MIT, one-click self-deploy, no monthly fee.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
